content: I just started my PhD in Stockholm University under Olof Sisask. I will not be working on formalisation (shocking!). However there is no doubt I will organise some kind of activities around Lean and theorem proving, be it a seminar or informal meetups.

This year I have been running the semisecret Stockholm Lean User Group (SLUG) at Stockholm Uni. Attendance has been low but loyal, with several projects being born at SLUG. It is now time to decide what we will do next year. We are thinking about going public and structuring the meetings more.
First I would like to know how many people are potentially interested by such meetings. Could you react to this message if you suspect you could be coming regularly next autumn?
